app.name: Chorizo Lab
app.tagline: Chorizo and sausage recipes with automatic scaling

home.heroTitle: Your chorizo recipes, scaled to the gram (and the pound)
home.heroSubtitle: Enter the recipe once. Then scale automatically to any amount of meat, in any unit: g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, fl oz, cups, tablespoons and more.

features.calculate: Instant ingredient scaling from meat weight
features.calculateDesc: Mark ingredients as % of the meat weight or use absolute amounts (g, oz, ml, fl oz, cm, pieces).
features.versionDesc: Each time you tweak something you save a new numbered version with your note. Never lose an iteration.
features.shareDesc: Share recipes, fork your friend's to experiment, and propose changes back like on GitHub.
features.social: Favorites, ratings, comments and cooking tips
features.socialDesc: The community rates and shares cooking tips for every recipe.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.demoIntro: Change the meat weight (in kg, lb, oz or g) and watch each ingredient recalculate instantly. Each row uses its preferred unit.
